tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour: section tabs, pills and the ground for reversed logos. Use as a fill or non-text mark on `paper`, `white` or `navy` (3.1–4.6:1). White text on it passes only at 24px and above (3.30:1); smaller text on teal uses `navy` (4.55:1).

tokens.name: teal-light
tokens.usage: The deck's documented "Teal" (CMYK 65/0/35/0): agility and adaptability. Linework in the patterns on `deep-teal` (3.7:1) and accent text or marks on `navy` (6.48:1). Not for text on light grounds.

tokens.name: seafoam
tokens.usage: Outermost layer of the symbol. Text or marks on `navy` (7.24:1) and `charcoal` (8.13:1). Fill only on light grounds.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: The river highlight inside the symbol. Marks on `navy` (8.67:1); fill only on light grounds.

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: The lit cave opening in the symbol. Text on `navy` (11.09:1) and on `deep-teal` (6.32:1); dark `navy` text on it passes at 11.09:1.

tokens.name: lagoon
tokens.usage: Mid layer of the symbol and the accent-text colour on light grounds: links and small teal-family text on `paper` (5.29:1) and `white` (5.62:1).

tokens.name: deep-teal
tokens.usage: Ground of all three brand patterns and a symbol layer. White text on it passes at 8.57:1; `mist` at 6.32:1; `teal-light` linework at 3.69:1.

tokens.name: abyss
tokens.usage: The shadow side of the symbol. White text on it passes at 12.52:1.

tokens.name: midnight
tokens.usage: Ink of the Arabic wordmark and descriptor, and the deepest symbol layer. White text on it passes at 15.77:1. Not the same as `navy`.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: The deck's documented "Navy" (CMYK 100/85/43/47): infrastructure, security, backend stability. Ink of the English wordmark, body text on `paper` (14.15:1) and `white` (15.03:1), and the dark ground.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Black ground used to show the reversed logo. White text on it passes at 16.88:1.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Reversed logo and text on `teal` (large only), `navy`, `charcoal`, `abyss`, `midnight` and `deep-teal`.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Light page ground. The deck sets it as a faint grey brushed texture; use the flat colour in product.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Secondary swatch from the deck (the deck leaves the six secondary colours unnamed; the names here are ours). Fill only: 2.0:1 on `paper`. Text on it uses `navy` (7.08:1).

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Secondary swatch. Fill only: 2.5:1 on `white`. Text on it uses `navy` (6.03:1). Sampled from the deck image, so the value is within a step or two of the original.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: Secondary swatch. Fill only on light grounds; text on it uses `navy` (7.94:1); marks on `navy` pass at 7.9:1.

tokens.name: magenta
tokens.usage: Secondary swatch. Text and marks on `paper` (7.6:1); white text on it passes at 8.09:1.

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Secondary swatch. Text and marks on `paper` (10.0:1); white text on it passes at 10.66:1.

tokens.name: snow
tokens.usage: Secondary swatch, the cool off-white. Fill only.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background in each theme. In the Black theme it is `charcoal`, the deck's black ground: near-black, not pure black.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and panels sitting on `surface`. Text on it uses `ink` and `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Deliberately opposite panels and covers. Text on it uses `ink-inverse`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on `surface` and `surface-raised`: 14.2–15.0:1 in light, 12.6–15.0:1 in dark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `surface` and `surface-raised`: 6.2:1 on `paper` and 6.5:1 on `white` in light; 7.7:1 or more in dark.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on `surface-inverse`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only. Carries no meaning, so it is not held to 3:1.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs and other controls: 4.1:1 on `paper` in light, 5.0:1 on `surface-raised` and 5.5:1 on `navy` in dark.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Fills of primary actions, tabs and markers. 3.1:1 on `paper` and 4.55:1 on `navy`, so it stands as a mark in both themes. Never for small text.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent`: 4.55:1. Text of 24px and above may be `white` (3.30:1). In the Black theme it is `charcoal` (5.1:1 on `teal`).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links and small accent text on `surface` and `surface-raised`: 5.3:1 on `paper` in light; 7.2:1 on `navy` and 6.1:1 on `surface-raised` in dark.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Solid 2px focus outline with a 2px offset on `surface` and `surface-raised`: 5.3:1 or more in light, 6.1:1 or more in dark.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Fill of primary actions (Button primary, active toggles). White text on it in light (5.6:1); `on-accent-strong` (navy) on `teal` in dark (4.55:1). Use `accent` only for brand marks and tabs.

tokens.name: on-accent-strong
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `accent-strong`: 5.6:1 in light, 4.55:1 in dark. In the Black theme it is `charcoal` on `teal` (5.1:1).

tokens.name: accent-strong-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of `accent-strong`. White on it 8.57:1 in light; navy on it 7.24:1 in dark.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet brand tint: selected nav item, brand badge, highlighted row. Text on it uses `accent-text` (about 4.9:1 in light, 6:1 or more in dark).

tokens.name: accent-soft-border
tokens.usage: Hairline around `accent-soft` surfaces. Decorative, carries no meaning.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Fill of destructive actions. White text on it in light (5.5:1); `on-danger` (navy) in dark (5.0:1).

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `danger`. In the Black theme it is `charcoal` on `danger` (5.6:1).

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of `danger`. White on it in light (7.5:1); navy on it in dark (6.2:1).

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Table header rows, skeletons, input wells and neutral badges sitting on `surface` or `surface-raised`. Text on it uses `ink` and `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of rows, menu items and quiet buttons.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and sheets. Darker in Black (70%).

tokens.name: disabled-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of disabled buttons and inputs. Disabled controls are exempt from contrast rules.

tokens.name: disabled-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons of disabled controls.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Background of success badges, banners and rows. Completed, paid, in stock, active. Text on it uses `success-fg` (4.5:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: success-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons for success on `success-bg`, `surface` and `surface-raised`. Always pair with a word or icon: success and error differ little in lightness.

tokens.name: success-border
tokens.usage: Hairline around success surfaces. Decorative.

tokens.name: success-solid
tokens.usage: Dots, bars and chart marks for success (3:1 or more on `surface` in both themes). Not for text.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges, banners and rows. Needs attention: low stock, expiring, pending. Text on it uses `warning-fg` (4.5:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: warning-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons for warning on `warning-bg`, `surface` and `surface-raised`. Always pair with a word or icon: success and error differ little in lightness.

tokens.name: warning-border
tokens.usage: Hairline around warning surfaces. Decorative.

tokens.name: warning-solid
tokens.usage: Dots, bars and chart marks for warning (3:1 or more on `surface` in both themes). Not for text.

tokens.name: error-bg
tokens.usage: Background of error badges, banners and rows. Failed, overdue, cancelled, destructive. Text on it uses `error-fg` (4.5:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: error-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons for error on `error-bg`, `surface` and `surface-raised`. Always pair with a word or icon: success and error differ little in lightness.

tokens.name: error-border
tokens.usage: Hairline around error surfaces. Decorative.

tokens.name: error-solid
tokens.usage: Dots, bars and chart marks for error (3:1 or more on `surface` in both themes). Not for text.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Background of info badges, banners and rows. Neutral news, tips, in progress. Text on it uses `info-fg` (4.5:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: info-fg
tokens.usage: Text and icons for info on `info-bg`, `surface` and `surface-raised`. Always pair with a word or icon: success and error differ little in lightness.

tokens.name: info-border
tokens.usage: Hairline around info surfaces. Decorative.

tokens.name: info-solid
tokens.usage: Dots, bars and chart marks for info (3:1 or more on `surface` in both themes). Not for text.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: First series, and the only series of a single-series chart: lagoon on light (5.3:1 on paper), seafoam on dark (7.2:1 on navy).

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Second series: magenta on light (7.6:1), coral on dark (6.0:1). Differs from `chart-1` in lightness and hue.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third series: a darkened coral on light (4.5:1), lime on dark (7.9:1).

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth series: navy on light, mist on dark. Never add a fifth; group the rest as Other.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero, English. Page titles and cover lines. Sentence case or capitals, as in the deck's GOAL and SYMBOLS tabs.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Hero, English. Section titles.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.usage: Hero, English. Headings, and the text of a `SectionTag` set in white on `teal`.

styles.name: heading-md
styles.usage: Hero, English. Sub-headings. The smallest size at which white text on `teal` passes.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: Poppins Regular. Lead paragraphs, as in the deck's goal statement.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Poppins Regular. Default body copy.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Poppins Regular. Secondary copy, table cells, footer contact lines.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Poppins Regular. Captions and fine print.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Poppins SemiBold. Emphasis inside body copy and callout titles (the deck uses Poppins Bold for these).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Poppins Medium, set in capitals with wide tracking. Short labels only, never sentences. The old descriptor line under the wordmark used this treatment.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Poppins SemiBold. Page titles inside the products (consoles, POS, app bars). Hero stays for brand moments: landing, sign-in, splash.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Poppins SemiBold. Card and dialog titles.

styles.name: table-head
styles.usage: Poppins SemiBold. Table column headers and form section labels, in sentence case.

styles.name: ar-display
styles.usage: Almarai Light, Arabic. Titles and brand moments. About 1.18x the size of the English display so the two look equally light; Blue Ocean is far heavier than Hero and made the Arabic look bold beside it.

styles.name: ar-heading
styles.usage: Almarai Light, Arabic. Headings at brand moments.

styles.name: ar-body
styles.usage: Almarai Regular, Arabic. Body copy and the descriptor line. Set right to left with `dir="rtl"`.

styles.name: ar-body-sm
styles.usage: Almarai Regular, Arabic. Secondary copy and footer contact lines.

styles.name: ar-body-strong
styles.usage: Almarai Bold, Arabic. Emphasis and callout titles.

styles.name: ar-page-title
styles.usage: Almarai Bold, Arabic. Page titles inside the products. Brand moments use ar-display (Almarai Light).

styles.name: ar-section-title
styles.usage: Almarai Bold, Arabic. Card and dialog titles.

spacing.note: Proposed 4px base. space-1 to space-6 are indexed; space-12, space-32 and space-48 are named by pixels because the shipped apps use those steps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Proposed. Hairline gaps, icon-to-label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Proposed. Tight stacks; stroke weight of the cover's arches.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Proposed. Control padding, gaps between related items.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Proposed. Card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Proposed. Between groups within a section.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Proposed. Between sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Input padding, compact control padding, table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Page gutters on desktop, space between cards.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Large section gaps in product pages.

radius.note: Pill is read from the deck (the section tabs). The others are taken from the shipped web, mobile and POS apps so the three products and this system agree.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls inside dense tables, tags, thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, menu items and nav items. Rectangular controls, never pills.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and table cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs, bottom sheets and popovers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Image frames and hero panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: From the deck: the section tabs (GOAL, SYMBOLS, COLORS). Also badges, chips and avatars. Not buttons.

shadow.note: The brand is flat. Product surfaces use borders; shadows are only for layers that float above the page.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs and bottom sheets.

duration.note: Respect prefers-reduced-motion: drop transitions and shorten loops.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, focus and press transitions.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Opening and closing dialogs, menus, toasts.

tokens.name: easing-standard
tokens.usage: All transitions.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky headers and sidebars.

tokens.name: z-dropdown
tokens.usage: Menus and popovers.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Scrim and dialog.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts above everything.
